lines.trans: Traitors and spies are all around!
Chef, nobody is plotting evil against you.
You understand nothing about people, runt!
People often create problems for themselves.
Others mistakenly think the whole world is against them.
They are simply jealous of my great talent!

words.gloss: to envy, to be jealous of

lines.trans: But constant suspicions only ruin life.
Caution in the kitchen is never unnecessary.

words.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

lines.trans: Sometimes it is useful to simply trust your cooks.
I trust only my own frying pan.
With such a mood it is hard to enjoy life.
Enough lecturing me, go chop onions!
Right away, chef, I am already running to the kitchen.
Fear prevents people from seeing the truth around them.

words.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I can see the toy car.
She was running after me (around me).

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

завидовать.gloss: to envy, to be jealous of

examples.trans: I envy you in a good way.

examples.text: Никто против вас не замышляет зла.
examples.trans: Nobody is plotting evil against you.

meanings.note: the opposite of good: добро и зло = good and evil

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.
Sometimes it is useful to trust others.
Oh, there is snow all around here!
There was thick forest all around.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.note: сказать лишнего = to say too much

examples.trans: Yesterday I said too much to you.
Do you have a spare ticket?
Onion, salt, pepper — and that's all.
Chop the onion for the salad.

мешать.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.

meanings.note: the end of a quarrel or war
the plural is used only in this sense

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: to cut into portions or pieces

examples.text: Вот с таким настроением и иди к Аникееву.
examples.trans: Go to Anikeev in just that mood.
I am in a good mood today.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: playful derogatory nickname used by Chef Barinov for Max

examples.trans: Runt, are you still standing here?
The chef often called the newcomer a runt.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: Осторожность на кухне никогда не лишняя.
examples.trans: Caution in the kitchen is never unnecessary.
People mistakenly think about bad things.
It is useful to learn from mistakes.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?
The test drive is only for regular clients.

examples.text: Я тоже могу быть постоянным клиентом!
examples.trans: I can be a regular client too!

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
+ genitive; can stand alone: Я против = I'm against it

examples.trans: And his whole family is thrilled!
The children rejoiced at the first snow.

meanings.en: dear, darling, my friend (in address: родной мой)

meanings.note: родной брат = full brother; родной город = hometown

examples.text: Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!
examples.trans: Well then, my dear friend, to you!

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
pan with a handle used for frying food

examples.trans: A heavy frying pan was sizzling on the stove.

examples.text: Он быстро снял сковородку с огня.
examples.trans: He quickly took the frying pan off the heat.
You create unnecessary problems for us.
The artist creates a new painting.

examples.text: У этой девочки большой талант к музыке.
examples.trans: This girl has a great talent for music.

meanings.note: ordinal numeral: в третьем поколении = third-generation

examples.trans: He lives on the third floor.

meanings.note: requiring effort; impersonal: it is difficult

examples.trans: It is very hard to manage it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: impersonal, + genitive: денег не хватило = there wasn't enough money

examples.text: О, это, Аркашенька, бывает очень часто.
examples.trans: Oh, that happens very often, Arkashenka.
We often meet in the park.
There are a lot of people here.
You don't read the small print.
I am reading an interesting book.
It's a film about a spy.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
